proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_numeric.damageTypeFilter
proposed_widenings.justification: The CHA-modifier rider only applies when the spell deals the chosen damage type. modify_damage_numeric has weaponFilter to scope by weapon, but no analogous damageTypeFilter to scope by damage type. Without it the atom would apply to ALL damage rolls, which is incorrect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell

proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_numeric.count
proposed_widenings.justification: The rider applies to exactly one damage roll per qualifying spell, not to all damage rolls while the effect persists. modify_roll_numeric already has a count field for this purpose; modify_damage_numeric needs the same field.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell

proposed_widenings.name: shared_build_time_choice binding
proposed_widenings.justification: Both the resistance grant and the damage modifier must reference the same player-chosen damage type (selected once when the feature is acquired). The surface currently has no mechanism to express that two atoms share a single CastTimeChoice selection — two independent CastTimeChoice<DamageType> fields in two separate atom instances would imply two independent picks.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type...

notes: Part 1 (grant_resistance with CastTimeChoice<DamageType> over {acid,cold,fire,lightning,poison}) fits the current surface cleanly. Part 2 (add CHA mod to one damage roll of a qualifying spell) cannot be encoded honestly: modify_damage_numeric needs a damageTypeFilter and a count field analogous to modify_roll_numeric. Additionally, both parts must be bound to a single shared build-time choice, which the surface cannot currently express. No Dhall or trace file written.
